description: This is a Kotlin source file defining an Android activity 'NoteDetailActivity' for displaying and editing note details in a note-taking app. It handles loading, saving, and deleting note data via a content provider.

classes.name: NoteDetailActivity
classes.description: An Android activity for viewing and editing the details of a note, including loading the note, saving updates, and deleting the note.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the UI, handles intent extras to determine if creating a new note or editing an existing one, and sets button click listeners.

methods.name: loadNote
methods.description: Queries the content provider for the note with the specified ID and populates UI fields with its data.

methods.name: saveNote
methods.description: Collects data from UI, inserts new note or updates existing note in the content provider, and closes the activity.

methods.name: confirmDelete
methods.description: Shows a confirmation dialog before deleting the current note or simply finishes if the note is new.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes the note with the specified ID from the content provider and closes the activity.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu options, specifically the 'up' navigation button to finish the activity.
